description: Save a UK (Companies House) or Irish (CRO) company from its official register onto the user's AccountsOS company: registered name, number, status, address, directors, year-end and filing deadlines. Call it only after lookup_company found the company and the user confirmed it is theirs. Returns the year-end and the deadlines it set up: tell the user what they are.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

company_number.description: The confirmed Companies House number to link and save.

name: link_company
title: Link Company From Register
